property_summary: Once a fallback call succeeds at timestamp t1, any later fallback call at timestamp t2 <= t1 must revert, keeping pastBlockTime monotonically increasing; the mutant deletes this guard, so the second call succeeds and pastBlockTime decreases.
change_summary: Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) guard so calls with smaller timestamps succeed and update pastBlockTime, changing the observable value.
